fields.ic_name: ARM Serial Wire Debug (SWD) — ADIv5 (ARM IHI 0031C)
must_have_properties: Two mandatory dedicated pins: SWCLK (host-driven) and SWDIO (bidirectional).
Every transaction consists of exactly 46 bits in order: 8-bit Request + 1-bit Turnaround + 3-bit ACK + 32-bit Data + 1-bit Data Parity + 1-bit Turnaround.
Request packet field layout: bit0=Start=1, bit1=APnDP, bit2=RnW, bit3=A[2], bit4=A[3], bit5=Parity (even over APnDP+RnW+A[2:3]), bit6=Stop=0, bit7=Park=1.
ACK encoding: OK=001, WAIT=010, FAULT=100 (one-hot only); LSB first on SWDIO.
Data: 32 bits LSB first, plus a 33rd parity bit (even parity over the 32 data bits).
DPIDR (DP IDCODE) register at A[3:2]=0x0 read; bit 0 hard-wired to 1 (RAO).
ABORT register at A[3:2]=0x0 write; supports DAPABORT + STKCMPCLR + STKERRCLR + WDERRCLR + ORUNERRCLR.
CTRL/STAT register at A[3:2]=0x4; includes CSYSPWRUPREQ/ACK + CDBGPWRUPREQ/ACK + sticky-error bits.
SELECT register at A[3:2]=0x8 write; supports APSEL[31:24] + APBANKSEL[7:4] + DPBANKSEL[3:0].
RDBUFF register at A[3:2]=0xC read; returns the data of the last posted AP read.
Up to 256 Access Ports addressable via SELECT.APSEL[7:0].
Each AP exposes 16 × 32-bit registers (64-byte window) at A[3:2] addresses 0x0/0x4/0x8/0xC banked by APBANKSEL.
MEM-AP register catalog at minimum: CSW (0x00), TAR (0x04), DRW (0x0C), CFG (0xF4), BASE (0xF8), IDR (0xFC).
MEM-AP BASE points to a CoreSight ROM Table (or zero with Present=0).
Line reset = ≥ 50 consecutive SWCLK cycles with SWDIO held HIGH from any state returns SW-DP to Idle.
Post-reset host first transaction is an IDCODE/DPIDR read.
Posted reads: data of read N is returned with the ACK of read N+1; final read via DP.RDBUFF.
must_have_if_swj_dp_present: 16-bit JTAG-to-SWD selection sequence 0xE79E (LSB first) shall be recognized.
16-bit SWD-to-JTAG selection sequence 0xE73C (LSB first) shall be recognized.
Both selection sequences shall be preceded by ≥ 50 cycles of TMS/SWDIO=HIGH and followed by ≥ 50 cycles of TMS/SWDIO=HIGH (line reset in both modes).
must_have_if_adiv5_1_plus: TARGETID register at DP bank 2; bit 0 = 1 (RAO).
DLPIDR register at DP bank 3 (multi-drop SWD).
must_have_if_adiv5_2_multidrop: TARGETSEL transaction (DP bank 3 write) shall route subsequent transactions only to the matching target.
All non-addressed targets shall ignore the bus after a TARGETSEL mismatch.
must_not_have_properties: Request packet with Start=0, Stop=1, or Park=0.
ACK code other than 001/010/100 (e.g. 000, 011, 101, 110, 111 are protocol errors).
Data parity bit not equal to the even parity of the 32 data bits.
SWD pins shared with functional pins (must be dedicated debug pins in SWD-only SoCs; SWJ-DP shares with JTAG only).
MEM-AP IDR.Class != 8 (any value other than 8 = not a MEM-AP).
Posted reads where the data of read N is returned with the ACK of read N (instead of N+1) — this is the classic 'flat read' bug.

compliance_failure_modes.trigger: DPIDR bit 0 not RAO (host sees stuck-at-zero indistinguishable from a real DPIDR=0).
SW-DP does not honor ≥ 50-cycle SWDIO=HIGH as line reset.
ABORT.STKERRCLR (or other clear bits) does not actually clear CTRL/STAT sticky bits.
AP returns data at ACK of read N instead of read N+1, or RDBUFF returns stale data.

compliance_failure_modes.mode: SWJ-DP cannot switch from JTAG to SWD
compliance_failure_modes.trigger: Selection sequence 0xE79E not recognized (typically MSB-vs-LSB shift bug).

compliance_failure_modes.mode: SWJ-DP cannot switch from SWD to JTAG

compliance_failure_modes.trigger: Multiple targets drive SWDIO simultaneously after TARGETSEL mismatch — addressed target's DLPIDR.TINSTANCE not unique.
STICKYERR not set on system-bus DECERR/SLVERR; host sees OK but data is undefined.
MEM-AP CSW.AddrInc=Single not actually incrementing TAR after DRW, or wrong wrap-around at 4 KB boundary.
Target releases SWDIO too early or too late relative to host drive — needs CTRL/STAT.TRNCNT increase.

fields.reset_behavior_compliance: After line reset (50-cycle SWDIO=HIGH) or power-on: SW-DP wire-level FSM returns to Idle; DP.SELECT cleared (APSEL=APBANKSEL=DPBANKSEL=0); CTRL/STAT cleared (sticky bits and power-up acknowledges all 0); posted-read queue drained; CDBGPWRUPACK and CSYSPWRUPACK may take time to deassert as the SoC's debug power domain drops. The first host transaction must be an IDCODE/DPIDR read.
